title: Observability: write() on KEY fd returns -ENODEV without log
description: crypto2dev_fd_write() checks 'if (state->fd_type != CRYPTO2DEV_FDTYPE_OPERATION) { ret = -ENODEV; goto out; }' (line 402-404) for KEY fds with no log. KEY fds accept write() when UNSET (for key data accumulation before KEY_IMPORT), but once they are in FDTYPE_KEY state they reject write(). An app that mistakenly calls write() on a KEY fd after import gets -ENODEV indistinguishable from device not found. A support engineer sees write() → -ENODEV and cannot determine if the fd is the wrong type or uninitialized. Fix: add pr_info_ratelimited before the -ENODEV return logging fd_type. Location: crypto2dev_fd.c line 402.
